reason: Conversation 2 reached the correct diagnosis, out-of-balance protection with a single heavy bath mat, within two turns. It asked the right first questions (what was in the drum, whether water remained) and explicitly said no fault and no part needed. Conversation 1 wrongly said an empty machine should still spin, then pushed filter cleaning, door lock, motor sensor and control board theories, and suggested an engineer before the customer's towel test showed there was no fault. It did land on the right conclusion in the end, but only after unnecessary steps and unsupported fault speculation.
